apps.name: Health
apps.description: One place for your health numbers: weight, blood pressure, water, caffeine and alcohol, with charts and statistics. Add values by hand or let other apps send them once you allow it, plus a public web page.

apps.name: Hydration
apps.description: Log what you drink through the day. Every drink counts only its own water content and also tracks caffeine and alcohol, with ready-made drinks and your own, plus a public web page.
